utility.notes: Azusa Light & Water is the City of Azusa's own municipal electric utility. Azusa is notably absent from SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (which lists neighboring San Gabriel Valley cities like Glendora, Duarte, Monrovia, and Arcadia but not Azusa), consistent with Azusa having its own municipal utility rather than SCE service. The utility's own page title ('Solar PV System Installation Procedures') and a dedicated Net Generator Payment (NGP) schedule page confirm Azusa Light & Water administers its own solar interconnection and net-metering-equivalent program, though azusaca.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, so specific page content could not be independently read or verified.

value.name: Azusa Light & Water
value.notes: Vertically-integrated municipal utility (like LADWP, Pasadena Water and Power, Alameda Municipal Power, and Anaheim Public Utilities) — generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA. No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Azusa in the sources reviewed this session.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) is not applicable to Azusa, since Azusa Light & Water is a municipal utility outside SGIP's administering IOUs' territories. No Azusa-specific battery incentive program was confirmed this session.
